definition.description: REV | Portal | Round Statistics. TAD ADR-038, S5.1.1. Dataverse row trigger; reads NOTHING from its trigger body (S6.3.1); writes one aggregate row. A-FLOW-03/04/06/07 open: SecureOutputs, failure path, $expand, result-table names. notes.md.

When_a_refresh_is_requested.description: Row MODIFIED on the request table. message 3 = Modified, read live 2026-08-28 from the callbackregistration option set; 2 is DELETED, so ADR-038's literal 2 registers a dead trigger (A-R47). scope 4. runas 3 - 4 registers no webhook (IMP-0108).

Capture_computedOn.description: Captured ONCE, before any read (TAD S3.3 property 5) -- the whole document shares this one stamp so the figures read as a coherent snapshot. Kept FIRST deliberately: the result-row read below is still the first Dataverse read. See notes.md.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Holds the failed action's detail for the alert. Top level ONLY: the scope that fails is skipped from the failure onward, so nothing inside it can carry a value out. Pattern: REVScoringDailySummary.

Compose_run_link.description: Deep link to THIS run, built at the top so all THREE alert paths share it. Must be built here, not in the child: workflow() inside REV | Ops | Failure Alert returns the child's own identity, not this caller's.

Read_the_result_row.description: TAD S5.1.1 point 4: read FIRST, so an unseeded row is diagnosed in one cheap call rather than after tallying a whole round. List rows + row-count guard, NEVER Get a row by ID on the alternate key (IMP-0112). Not personal data - no Secure Outputs.

Alert_result_row_unreadable.description: The row could not be READ at all - table, privilege or connection. Alerted rather than left as a bare run failure, because this flow holds no Create privilege on that table by design and cannot self-heal. TAD S3.9.4, A-R46/A-R49.

body.text_2: Could not read rev_roundstatisticsresults (key CURRENT). Check the table exists and that REV Service Automation holds Read on it. No figures were computed and nothing was written.

Stop_run_result_row_unreadable.description: Skipped is deliberately NOT accepted: on every healthy run the alert above is skipped, and accepting Skipped here would terminate every healthy run. Same reasoning as the D-10 fix on the error write-back below.

runError.message: rev_roundstatisticsresults could not be read. No figures were computed and no row was written.

Check_exactly_one_result_row.description: Exactly one row, key CURRENT. The then-branch is deliberately EMPTY and the else-branch is the hard failure: zero means provisioning never seeded it (TAD S3.9.4), two is impossible while the alternate key holds. Diagnosed BEFORE the privileged read.

Alert_result_row_not_provisioned.description: Diagnosed as 'not provisioned', which is the actual fault: seed-round-statistics-result.ps1 has not run for this environment. TAD S3.9.4 requires the row to exist before the first trigger, because the flow updates it and holds no Create.

body.text_2: @{concat('rev_roundstatisticsresults holds ', string(length(body('Read_the_result_row')?['value'])), ' row(s) with rev_name CURRENT, expected exactly 1. Seed the result row for this environment. No figures were computed and nothing was written.')}

Stop_run_result_row_not_provisioned.description: Fails the run so the outcome is not reported as success. There is no row to write a status onto, which is exactly why this path alerts instead of writing.

runError.message: rev_roundstatisticsresults has no single row keyed CURRENT. Seed it before the first trigger; the flow holds no Create privilege on that table.

Compose_result_row_id.description: The GUID every write-back below targets. A-FLOW-07: rev_roundstatisticsresultid is the platform CONVENTION, E1 on the sibling table via x-ms-dataverse-primary-id, but not yet read back for THIS table. notes.md.

Compute_statistics.description: Wraps the round read and branch (TAD S5.1) so ANY failure inside reaches one catch: Failure Alert + a status=error document written to the result row (TAD S5.1 On-failure row, S3.3). See notes.md.

List_the_open_round.description: TAD section 5.1: List rev_roundfinance, rev_isopen eq true, top 2. Not personal data (section 3.5) -- no Secure Outputs needed here.

Read_the_freshness_bound.description: TAD S3.3 property 7 / S5.3.1: staleAfterSeconds. rev_setting.rev_value is ntext (Entities/rev_setting/Entity.xml:33) so this arrives as a STRING. An absent row is the expected DEV state and the fail-safe default (OQ-042). Not personal data.

Compose_stale_setting_raw.description: Row-count guard: anything other than exactly one row yields the empty string, which the two actions below turn into the JSON literal null. No numeric cast here on purpose -- int() on a mistyped tunable would fail the whole computation. See notes.md.

Compose_stale_setting_nondigits.description: Everything that is NOT a digit, found by stripping 0-9. Empty means the raw value is digits only. replace/empty are total, so neither branch of the if() below can throw whichever argument-evaluation order the platform uses. See notes.md.

Compose_stale_after_seconds.description: A JSON NUMBER when the setting holds a plain non-negative integer, else the JSON literal null -- which TAD S3.3 property 7 defines as 'always recompute', the fail-safe. Leading zeros are rejected because 007 is not valid JSON. Spliced UNQUOTED below.

Compose_no_open_round_document.description: TAD S3.3 property 4: a non-ok status carries NO figures. staleAfterSeconds travels even here so the screen has a bound whatever the outcome (S3.3 property 7, ADR-038).

Write_no_open_round_result.description: item/<column> keys FLAT beside entityName and recordId. A nested item object writes NOTHING while succeeding -- a green run and an empty column, no error (IMP-0116). Status Error: no figures were produced. Never writes the table it triggers on (S6.3.2).

List_applications_in_round.description: TAD S5.1: all round rows, no eligibility filter. Secure Outputs ON. $expand adds the round's applicant demographic fields per row (A-FLOW-06 -- notes.md); wellbeing/life-satisfaction columns live on this table directly.

Compose_truncated_document.description: The page cap is a hard stop, not a truncation (TAD S5.1 property 3): a subset produces plausible, WRONG percentages, so no figures are emitted at all.

Write_truncated_result.description: item/<column> keys FLAT beside entityName and recordId; a nested item object writes NOTHING while succeeding (IMP-0116). Status Error: no figures were produced. Deliberately unsecured outputs -- the aggregate is not personal data (S6.4.1).

Compose_round_opened_on.description: A-FLOW-10: rev_roundopenedon is DateTimeBehavior=DateOnly, so $select returns '2026-08-01' with no time part, and ticks()/formatDateTime() over that shape appear nowhere else in these five flows. Entered, never derived (TAD S3.5). notes.md.

Compose_applications_per_day.description: A-FLOW-09: days = whole elapsed days from the open date to computedOn, floored, min 1 so the opening day is day 1. BOTH if() branches are total, so argument-evaluation order cannot throw (IMP-0378, IMP-0412). No open date emits null, never 0. notes.md.

Compose_exceptionalcircumstance_categori.description: Assembles exceptionalCircumstanceMix categories -- the 4 rev_exceptionalcircumstance options, same array shape as the gender/agerange/applicanttype arrays above. FR-059, TAD S3.3. notes.md.

Compose_exceptional_funding_summary.description: FR-059. averageAmountRequested is now composed (ADR-039) as {value,population} over the rows that asked AND recorded a figure -- a population that is NOT anyCount. Spliced UNQUOTED: the action emits either an object or the JSON literal null.

Compose_breaktype_rows.description: FR-060 rows, one per rev_breaktype option. ADR-039: each of the three money measures is now {value,population} or the JSON literal null, spliced UNQUOTED. A row below k publishes its COUNT and no money figures -- intended, not an error.

Compose_breaktype_total.description: FR-060 total row. count is five operands nested four deep. ADR-039: the three money measures are derived from the five per-type subsets rather than re-filtering the round, so the total's populations equal the sum of the rows'. A-LAND-4.

Compose_breaktype_profile.description: FR-060 breakTypeProfile: the round population, the five rows and the total row. Every key written by name (TAD S3.3 property 6). notes.md.

Compose_response_body.description: Every key written BY NAME from an enumerated field list -- never a serialised row (TAD S3.3 property 6, S6.3.3). FOURTH VERSION wires FR-058 applicationsPerDay and FR-059/FR-060 (D-11 fix). ethnicGroup + the 3 OQ-039 proportions stay null. notes.md.

Write_ok_result.description: The ONE write this flow makes on its happy path. item/<column> keys FLAT beside entityName and recordId; a nested item object writes NOTHING while succeeding (IMP-0116). Status Complete. Outputs deliberately UNSECURED -- aggregate only (S6.4.1).

Filter_breaktype1_cost_present.description: ADR-039 presence filter: break type 1 rows carrying a rev_costs figure. RequiredLevel None, so a blank is an UNKNOWN, never a zero -- coercing it would bias the mean downward. length() is this measure's own denominator.

Select_breaktype1_cost_values.description: ADR-039: projects one money value per row to a string for the XML sum. This is the Select ACTION, not the non-existent select() EXPRESSION (IMP-0124). One column, one scalar per row -- no identity and no free text enters the XML.

Compose_breaktype1_cost_sum.description: A-FLOW-11: xml() over a hand-built string and xpath(...,'sum(...)') have NEVER run on this tenant. XPath 1.0 sum() is NaN over ANY empty element and 0 over an empty node set, both measured -- so no <v> is emitted at all when the subset is empty.

Compose_breaktype1_average_cost.description: FR-060 averageCost as {value,population} -- its OWN denominator, which differs from the row count whenever a figure is blank (TAD S3.3 property 8). null below k (rev_setting, TAD S6.3.5). Both if() branches are total.

Filter_breaktype1_requested_present.description: ADR-039 presence filter: break type 1 rows carrying either requested amount. A-FLOW-12: FR-060's 'including exceptional funding' is read as the SUM of both columns, the same reading format.ts totalFundingRequested ships.

Select_breaktype1_requested_values.description: ADR-039: projects one money value per row to a string for the XML sum. This is the Select ACTION, not the non-existent select() EXPRESSION (IMP-0124). One column, one scalar per row -- no identity and no free text enters the XML.

Compose_breaktype1_average_requested.description: FR-060 averageAmountRequested as {value,population}, over both requested columns summed (A-FLOW-12). Own denominator, not the row count (TAD S3.3 property 8). null below k (TAD S6.3.5). Both if() branches are total.

Filter_breaktype1_both_present.description: ADR-039: the ONE both-present subset percentageOfCost is computed over (TAD S3.3 property 8) -- break type 1 rows with a cost AND a requested amount. Two independently-filtered sums would mix denominators in one row.

Compose_breaktype1_percentage_of_cost.description: FR-060 percentageOfCost as {value,population} -- one ratio of two sums over ONE both-present subset, carrying that third population (TAD S3.3 property 8). null below k, and null when the summed cost is under one currency unit.

Compose_breaktype3_percentage_of_cost.description: FR-060 percentageOfCost as {value,population} -- one ratio of two sums over ONE both-present subset, carrying that third population (TAD S3.3 property 8). null below k, and null when the summed cost is under one currency unit.

Filter_breaktype4_cost_present.description: ADR-039 presence filter: break type 4 rows carrying a rev_costs figure. RequiredLevel None, so a blank is an UNKNOWN, never a zero -- coercing it would bias the mean downward. length() is this measure's own denominator.

Compose_breaktype_total_cost_population.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type presence populations, added. add() is strictly binary so five operands nest four deep -- the shape the total count has used since the fourth version. Equals the sum of the row populations.

Compose_breaktype_total_cost_sum.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type xpath sums, added. Deriving the total from the rows rather than re-filtering the round is what keeps the total row and the five data rows arithmetically consistent (A-FLOW-11 applies to each summand).

Compose_breaktype_total_average_cost.description: FR-060 total row average as {value,population}, over the same presence subsets the five rows use. null when nothing is present and null below k (TAD S6.3.5). Both if() branches are total -- max(pop,1) cannot divide by zero.

Compose_breaktype_total_requested_popula.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type presence populations, added. add() is strictly binary so five operands nest four deep -- the shape the total count has used since the fourth version. Equals the sum of the row populations.

Compose_breaktype_total_requested_sum.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type xpath sums, added. Deriving the total from the rows rather than re-filtering the round is what keeps the total row and the five data rows arithmetically consistent (A-FLOW-11 applies to each summand).

Compose_breaktype_total_average_requeste.description: FR-060 total row average as {value,population}, over the same presence subsets the five rows use. null when nothing is present and null below k (TAD S6.3.5). Both if() branches are total -- max(pop,1) cannot divide by zero.

Compose_breaktype_total_both_population.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type BOTH-present populations, added. This is percentageOfCost's own third denominator (TAD S3.3 property 8) and is not the cost or requested population beside it.

Compose_breaktype_total_both_cost_sum.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type both-present cost sums, added. Both halves of the ratio come from the SAME subset, which is the whole point of the both-present filter (TAD S3.3 property 8).

Compose_breaktype_total_both_requested_s.description: FR-060 total row: the five per-type both-present requested sums, added. Both halves of the ratio come from the SAME subset, which is the whole point of the both-present filter (TAD S3.3 property 8).

Compose_breaktype_total_percentage_of_co.description: FR-060 total row percentageOfCost as {value,population} -- one ratio of two sums over ONE both-present subset. null when empty, null below k, and null when the summed cost is under one currency unit. Both if() branches are total.

Filter_exceptionalfunding_amount_present.description: ADR-039 presence filter for FR-059's average exceptional funding requested: rows that asked AND carry a rev_additionalamountrequested figure. RequiredLevel None, so a blank is an unknown. length() is this measure's own denominator, not anyCount.

Select_exceptionalfunding_amount_values.description: ADR-039: projects one money value per row to a string for the XML sum. This is the Select ACTION, not the non-existent select() EXPRESSION (IMP-0124). One column, one scalar per row -- no identity and no free text enters the XML.

Compose_exceptionalfunding_amount_sum.description: A-FLOW-11: xml() over a hand-built string and xpath(...,'sum(...)') have NEVER run on this tenant. XPath 1.0 sum() is NaN over ANY empty element and 0 over an empty node set, both measured -- so no <v> is emitted at all when the subset is empty.

Compose_exceptionalfunding_average_amoun.description: FR-059 averageAmountRequested as {value,population} over rev_additionalamountrequested. Its population is NOT the anyCount beside it -- a row can ask and record no figure (TAD S3.3 property 8). null below k (TAD S6.3.5).

Compose_ambiguous_round_document.description: Two or more open rounds is a failure, not a guess (TAD S5.1 property 4). FR-057 asserts one round at a time, so the invariant is asserted here rather than assumed and a round is never picked arbitrarily.

Write_ambiguous_round_result.description: item/<column> keys FLAT beside entityName and recordId; a nested item object writes NOTHING while succeeding (IMP-0116). Status Error: no figures were produced.

Read_the_money_measure_minimum.description: TAD S6.3.5 / ADR-039 part 2: k, the minimum own-population at which a money average is published. rev_value is ntext, so this arrives as a STRING. An absent row withholds all four measures: fail-safe, but NOT the approved state (S12.1). Not personal data.

Compose_money_minimum_raw.description: Row-count guard: anything other than exactly one row yields the empty string, which the two actions below turn into the withholding sentinel. No numeric cast here -- int() on a mistyped disclosure control would fail the whole computation.

Compose_money_minimum_nondigits.description: Everything that is NOT a digit, found by stripping 0-9. Empty means the raw value is digits only. replace/empty are total, so neither branch of the if() below can throw whichever argument-evaluation order the platform uses (IMP-0378/IMP-0412).

Compose_money_minimum_population.description: k as an INTEGER. An absent, empty or non-numeric setting yields 999999999 -- a threshold no round can reach under the 1000-row page cap -- so every money measure is withheld. int() is applied ONCE, to digits only, so it cannot throw.

Find_the_failed_action.description: The child of Compute_statistics whose status is Failed. Pattern: REVScoringDailySummary -- result(scope)[0] returns the FIRST child regardless of which one actually failed.

Describe_the_failure.description: When the failed child is Switch_on_open_round_count, descend into it -- result() on a container gives a generic wrapper message otherwise (IMP-0109, IMP-0349). Else the outer child IS the leaf. See notes.md.

Find_the_failed_step_inside_Switch_on_op.description: Only evaluated when Switch_on_open_round_count is the failed child, so result() on it is safe. A-FLOW-13 OPEN: Microsoft documents result() for Scope/For_each/Until only; Switch by name is unconfirmed.

Describe_the_switch_failure.description: Condition_page_cap is itself a container inside Exactly_one_open_round -- same descent, one level deeper (IMP-0349). Else the switch's failed step IS the leaf. See notes.md.

Find_the_failed_step_inside_Condition_pa.description: Only evaluated when Condition_page_cap is the failed step inside the Switch, so result() on it is safe. A-FLOW-13 OPEN: If by name carries the same unconfirmed contract as Switch.

Set_failure_detail_from_page_cap.description: The real leaf inside Condition_page_cap -- e.g. one of the thirteen A-FLOW-11 money-sum actions.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Condition_page_cap'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Condition_page_cap'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Condition_page_cap'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Set_failure_detail_from_the_switch.description: The failed step inside the Switch was not Condition_page_cap, so it is already the leaf.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Switch_on_open_round_count'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Switch_on_open_round_count'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Switch_on_open_round_count'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Set_failure_detail.description: The failed child was not Switch_on_open_round_count, so it is already the leaf. Pattern: REVScoringDailySummary.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Alert_on_failure.description: Severity Warning: a failed on-demand read costs one view of the dashboard, no data and no application is at risk, and the trustee can simply reload. See notes.md.

Compose_error_document.description: staleAfterSeconds is the literal null HERE AND ONLY HERE: the settings read lives inside the failed scope, so no bound can be vouched for. null means always recompute (S3.3 property 7) - the fail-safe and the right retry. No roundKey: notes.md.

Write_error_result.description: D-10 fix KEPT: Skipped is not accepted upstream, so on a healthy run this whole tail is skipped and cannot overwrite a good document. Status Error. item/<column> keys FLAT beside entityName and recordId (IMP-0116). See notes.md.
